The defeat of Proposition 40 also marks a setback for progressives seeking to tax the wealth of the ultra-rich.

events.title: Will Eisenkot succeed in 'minefield of Israeli politics' where 'so many other generals' have failed?
events.description: François Picard welcomes Dahlia Scheindlin, Israeli author, political analyst, strategic consultant and pollster, to examine a question that reaches far beyond the immediate struggle for power: Can Israel move beyond Netanyahu amid coalition deadlock, growing disillusionment in Washington and the persistent limits of political inclusion? As Gadi Eisenkot embarks on a 45-day race to form a government, following Israeli President Isaac Herzog's decision to entrust him with the task of assembling an elusive parliamentary majority, Scheindlin offers a timely reminder: “It's always too early to eulogize Netanyahu politically.” seemingly insurmountable political crises.

events.title: Republican congressman launches impeachment bid against Pentagon chief Hegseth
events.description: Kentucky congressman Thomas Massie moved on Monday to force a vote in the House of Representatives to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, putting pressure on his fellow Republicans to decide whether to remove one of the Trump administration’s most prominent figures following the party's crushing defeat in midterm elections.

events.title: FBI investigating Nvidia CEO over affair with alleged Chinese spy
events.description: Donald Trump has said the FBI is looking into Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's affair with an alleged Chinese spy - but insisted he is a "very honourable man".

events.title: Finland's navy chief says Russia's presence in the Baltic Sea may have peaked for now
events.description: Russia may have reached the limit of its "peacetime" ability to project force in the Baltic Sea, with the maritime situation "tense" but "stable", the head of Finland's navy has said.

events.title: Joe Biden scales back book tour as he reveals cancer treatment progress
events.description: Former US president Joe Biden said he won't be "able to have as many conversations" about his upcoming memoir as he would want to because of his cancer diagnosis.

events.title: Japan to provide coastal radar and drones to the Philippines under $27M deal
events.description: Japan said it will provide a coastal radar system and unmanned aircraft to the Philippines under a security aid deal, as both countries face growing tensions with China

events.title: He fought France's far right for half a century. Now Mélenchon's presidential bid may hand it power
events.description: Jean-Luc Mélenchon is 75 and he's betting his last shot at France’s presidency on a generation young enough to be his grandchildren

events.title: Pope draws 2.5M to Mass in Argentina, says people with disabilities are a blessing
events.description: Pope Leo XIV has drawn 2.5 million people to his first Mass in Argentina

events.title: Honduran court delays verdict in disappearance case that exposed sex trafficking ring
events.description: A Honduran court has postponed a verdict in a sex-trafficking case linked to the 2022 disappearance of Angie Peña

events.title: In Senegal, Black surfers want to reclaim the waves despite lack of resources
events.description: The origins of surfing can be traced back to the native populations of Peru, Polynesia and Hawaii, and European travelers documented children surfing along the coast of what is now Ghana as early as the 17th century

events.title: Pope meets with survivors of clergy abuse in Argentina as it reckons with legacy and ongoing cases
events.description: Pope Leo XIV have met with survivors of clergy abuse during his visit to Argentina

events.title: Russia's top independent newspaper closes after three decades, citing pressure
events.description: Russia’s most celebrated independent newspaper, Novaya Gazeta, has closed its Moscow offices, citing relentless pressure from the government

events.title: ‘For the first time I have my own chair’: Gaza siblings find new freedom
events.description: In Gaza, 10-year-old Anas is one of three siblings born without legs and with only two fingers on each of their hands. They struggle to move around and perform daily activities like eating and writing independently.

events.title: South Carolina dad left sleeping 6-year-old in line for Pokémon cards at Target: police
events.description: A South Carolina father allegedly left his 6-year-old asleep outside a Target overnight to hold his place in line for a Pokémon card release.

events.title: Trump says Air Force pilots described a round UFO flying three times faster than an F-22 fighter jet
events.description: Trump says Air Force pilots told him a round, non-aerodynamic object flew past an F-22 at three times its speed during a mysterious encounter.

events.title: MICHAEL RUIZ: Tyler Robinson judge gives long-awaited trial date ruling in assassination of Charlie Kirk
events.description: Tyler Robinson's trial date ruling comes Monday as prosecutors and defense clash over timelines in the Charlie Kirk assassination case.

events.title: GOP faces daunting post-election test as grip on Congress nears end and more top headlines
events.description: Get all the stories you need-to-know from the most powerful name in news delivered first thing every morning to your inbox.

events.title: Blue Angels pilot removed from team for 'failing to uphold' standards, Navy says
events.description: Blue Angels pilot Scott Laux was removed for failing to uphold team standards, forcing the squadron to fly five jets at its Pensacola season finale.

events.title: Alexander brothers allegedly paid for coverage of sex-trafficking trial as writers deny favorable treatment
events.description: The Alexander brothers each received 30 years in prison, but allegations that they paid journalists for favorable trial coverage add a new twist.

events.title: Three teens, adult charged with murder after woman finds her teenage son dead in abandoned home
events.description: Austin Payne's mother tracked his cellphone to an abandoned Albany, Georgia, residence after the 15-year-old called to say he had been shot.

events.title: Two experienced skydivers die after midair collision entangles their parachutes
events.description: The two skydivers collided midair at about 150 feet during an organized skydive in Southern California, entangling their parachutes.

events.title: Israeli president taps Netanyahu rival to form government as coalition battle looms
events.description: Gadi Eisenkot secured 67 Knesset endorsements over Benjamin Netanyahu, but deep coalition divisions over Arab parties and conscription cloud his path.

events.title: Oil-rich UAE makes massive AI bet as Sam Altman unveils ambitious plan to transform energy industry
events.description: OpenAI's Sam Altman named energy as his biggest challenge at ADIPEC 2026, where Abu Dhabi unveiled ambitious AI partnerships with ADNOC and G42.

events.title: Netanyahu faces coalition showdown as rivals maneuver to form Israel's next government
events.description: Benjamin Netanyahu faces a critical test as President Isaac Herzog decides who will receive the mandate to form Israel's next government.

events.title: US will mediate upcoming Ukraine-Russia talks in Abu Dhabi, Witkoff says
events.description: U.S. Special Envoy Steve Witkoff announced U.S.-mediated peace talks between Ukraine and Russia on Nov. 10 and 11, focusing on security arrangements and de-escalation.
